segments.title: Cream Company: Lethal Company Gaming Session
segments.notes: Case Blackwell hosts an extended Lethal Company co-op session with Fiona and Pepito (via snap camera filter), completing multiple moons, meeting quota, and experimenting with spray-paint navigation markers before raiding Gina's channel.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Appears in-game as a dog via snap camera filter, freestyles on the boombox, and is put in timeout for misbehavior.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Briefly appears on mic to acknowledge the session and discuss door-marking strategy.

lore_notes.fact: Received a Stanley water bottle gift intended for Kendall but claimed it for himself until she tires of it. [00:33]
Uses snap camera filter to appear as a dog in Lethal Company; purchases a boombox with in-game credits and freestyles until timeout. [05:51]
Confirms she and Case use spray-paint dots above doors for exits and to the side for dead ends as a navigation system. [30:06]
Raids Gina's channel at broadcast close, framing it as a 'Pepito raid' to squash playful beef. [01:43:39]

episode_summary: Case Blackwell opens the broadcast with a casual Lethal Company co-op run alongside Fiona and a snap-camera Pepito, successfully navigating multiple eclipsed moons, securing high-value loot, and meeting quota with a spray-paint marking system co-developed with Kendelle. The session closes with Case raiding Gina's channel, declaring it a 'Pepito raid' to resolve mock hostilities.
